text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that explicitly focuses on national-scale land use and land cover (LULC) prediction in mainland China from 2000 to 2060. It implements three distinct future policy scenarios—baseline, cropland protection, and green development—and quantitatively compares projected changes in multiple LULC classes (cropland, forest, grassland, water, built-up, unused land). The study uses the PLUS model for spatially explicit simulation, reports quantitative accuracy metrics (kappa = 0.827, OA = 0.878, FOM = 0.161), includes mapped projections for 2030 and 2060, and analyzes spatio-temporal dynamics and driving mechanisms. The methodology confirms a national-scale implementation excluding only Taiwan and South China Sea Islands, consistent with common practice in China-focused geospatial studies. All core inclusion criteria are met, and no exclusion criteria apply.)
